author: claude-design
method: Direct inspection of all13 final native shaded renders from the exact master and actual exported controller poses. No generated stand-in imagery or browser rendering.
resolved_findings: Inherited broad lower-ramp gap and aft triangular opening repaired; closed side/belly show continuous closing perimeter with visible seams.
Local inner rim bevel retains closed exterior fit and clears sampled ramp motion.
Transport versus gunship shows restored skin or the selected emplacement panels; inactive equipment is absent from the rendered configuration.
Tanker pod, flexible hose and open basket are visible in the deployed pose.
Fulton housing/braces contact the source nose; arms fold along the sides and deploy forward, with supported taut fending lines.
All eight JATO bottles remain outside source skin; visual exhaust is separate from physical aircraft behavior.
declared_limits: This is functional visual-asset review, not exact-aircraft or photorealistic acceptance.
Small local ramp-corner faceting and inherited surface/normal detail remain draft finishing work; not every seam is below5mm.
Exact receiver-cover mechanics, basket dimensions, Fulton endpoint details and JATO installation fidelity remain approximate.
846 sampled upper-door/skin contacts inside50mm hinge region remain declared, not certified intentional.
Continuous combined clearance, browser/WebGL and native Unreal remain unvalidated.
